newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Unocal cut to sell by UBS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Unocal cut to sell by UBS.

text.p: -- Unocal Corp was cut to a sell from a hold by UBS Securities on Thursday on price and earnings concerns.
-- Analyst Jeff Berg said in a research report, "We believe 1997 earnings will fall well short of current expectations due ... to declining U.S. oil/gas production and weaker downstream profits."
-- Berg also said he believes expectations of a spin-off of West Coast downstream operations, which have helped boost the stock over the past few months, are relatively unlikely.
